ticket_text: All devices at Sample Household Beta lost internet this morning. The gateway lights are normal.
Sample Household Gamma received a replacement gateway and can join its Wi-Fi, but internet setup never completes.
Sample Household Delta's porch camera stopped reporting after a power interruption. Other home devices are working.
Sample Household Epsilon stays connected to Wi-Fi but several websites fail to load.
One phone at Sample Household Alpha cannot join the home Wi-Fi, while other connected-home devices still work.
Sample Household Gamma's window sensor is offline following the gateway replacement.
Sample Household Zeta asks whether a service reminder in the account portal affects current connectivity.
Sample Household Delta says the porch camera remains offline even though the home Wi-Fi is available.
Sample Household Epsilon recently moved the router. The customer thinks the new hardware failed because websites no longer load.
Sample Household Beta replaced a router last week and now has no internet. The customer requests a replacement gateway.
Sample Household Alpha reports brief evening drops, but service is currently working and no exact times or affected devices were captured.
Sample Household Delta reports that a camera app says connected, while the camera has not sent an image since the power interruption.
Sample Household Zeta reports no internet despite a service reminder, but gives no affected-device details.
Sample Household Alpha reports occasional false alerts from its door sensor while the sensor currently appears connected.
Sample Household Gamma says a neighbour mentioned an outage, but this household's newly delivered gateway has never reached internet setup.
